name: NTT UD REIT Investment Corp
summary: Premier Investment Corporation (PIC) operates as a Japanese Real Estate Investment Trust (J-REIT), managing a varied portfolio that includes both commercial office properties and residential buildings. Its investment activities are strategically concentrated within the vibrant Tokyo Economic Bloc. PIC made its debut on the Tokyo Stock Exchange in September 2002, becoming the sixth J-REIT to list (ticker: 8956). Since then, it has substantially grown its asset base, with its portfolio now valued at over 200 billion yen based on acquisition costs. The company employs a sophisticated hedging strategy to minimize risk, capitalizing on the complementary nature of office and residential assets to withstand economic cycles. This, combined with its primary focus on Tokyo and judicious management of its financial structure, has enabled PIC to consistently provide strong and stable dividends throughout previous fiscal periods. Premier REIT Advisors, Co., Ltd. (PRA) is responsible for the professional management of PIC's assets. Both entities are committed to ensuring enduring operational stability and continuously elevating the quality of their owned properties for the medium to long term.
